ADAPT_EVENT_DOSELIMITAPPROACH: The session was approaching its cumulative light-energy limit — output was reduced to stay within the safe dose.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGALPHAHIGH: Brainwave activity in the calm-focus range was elevated — stimulation frequency was reduced to avoid over-stimulation.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGALPHALOW: Brainwave activity in the calm-focus range dipped — stimulation frequency was increased to support focus.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGBETAHIGH: Alertness-linked brainwave activity was elevated — stimulation was reduced to encourage relaxation.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGBETALOW: Alertness-linked brainwave activity dipped — stimulation was adjusted to maintain engagement.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGGAMMAHIGH: High-frequency brainwave activity was elevated — stimulation frequency was stepped down to prevent fatigue.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGGAMMALOW: High-frequency brainwave activity (linked to focus and attention) dipped — stimulation frequency was stepped up.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGTHETAHIGH: Brainwave activity in the memory-processing range was elevated — stimulation was reduced.
ADAPT_EVENT_EEGTHETALOW: Brainwave activity in the memory-processing range dipped — stimulation was adjusted to support memory encoding.
ADAPT_EVENT_HRVCOHERENCEHIGH: Heart rhythm coherence was above target — the breathing pacer rate was eased to maintain the effect without over-correction.
ADAPT_EVENT_HRVCOHERENCELOW: Heart rhythm coherence fell below your personal target — the breathing pacer rate was adjusted to help restore coherence.
ADAPT_EVENT_HRVRMSSDLOW: Heart rate variability fell below your baseline — stimulation intensity was reduced to lower physiological load.
ADAPT_EVENT_IMPEDANCECHANGE: Electrode contact quality changed during the session — stimulation was adjusted to account for the change.
ADAPT_EVENT_PHASETRANSITION: The session moved to a new phase — stimulation parameters were updated for the new phase.
ADAPT_EVENT_SESSIONENDRAMP: The session was completing — all stimulation was gradually reduced to zero.
ADAPT_EVENT_THERMALTHROTTLE: A device component reached its temperature limit — output was reduced temporarily to allow cooling.
ADAPT_EVENT_USERPAUSE: The session was paused — all stimulation was reduced to standby levels.

BIPA_STEP1_BODY_1: NeurOne captures electroencephalogram (EEG) data — the faint electrical signals produced when neurons in your brain fire. This data powers real-time neurofeedback and closed-loop stimulation during your sessions.
BIPA_STEP1_BODY_2: The next three screens explain how this data is protected, what it is used for, and the limits on how it can ever be used. Please read each one before deciding.
BIPA_STEP1_CARD: EEG brainwave patterns are biometric identifiers under Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14), special-category personal data under GDPR Article 9, and consumer health data under Washington MHMD. They identify you as uniquely as a fingerprint — and the law requires your explicit authorisation before we can collect them.
BIPA_STEP2_BODY: Your EEG data never leaves your NeurOne device. It lives in a dedicated encrypted partition that only you can unlock.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_1: Encrypted with AES-256 — the key is derived from your own biometric or PIN. NeurOne cannot generate or hold this key.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_2: Never transmitted to NeurOne servers, including for support, diagnostics, or troubleshooting.
BIPA_STEP2_BULLET_3: Backed up only to your own local storage or end-to-end encrypted personal cloud — never to NeurOne infrastructure.
BIPA_STEP3_BODY: Your brainwave data is used exclusively to deliver the NeurOne experience on your device. These are the only permitted uses, and the limits are absolute.
BIPA_STEP3_LIMIT_1: Sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your biometric data
BIPA_STEP3_LIMIT_2: Share it with any third party without your separate written consent, except as required by law
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_1: Session delivery — powering real-time neurofeedback and adapting stimulation parameters closed-loop
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_2: Displaying your own session results to you within the app
BIPA_STEP3_PURPOSE_3: Research, only with your separate explicit consent for each individual study

BIPA_STEP4_INTRO: Below is the legally required written release under BIPA (740 ILCS 14/15(b)) and the equivalent provisions of GDPR Article 9 and Washington MHMD. Please read it in full, then check the box and tap "I Authorize" to proceed.
BIPA_STEP4_RELEASE_TEXT:
I authorize NeurOne Inc. to collect, store, and use my electroencephalogram (EEG) brainwave data — which constitutes biometric identifiers and biometric information under Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14), special-category personal data under GDPR Article 9, and consumer health data under Washington MHMD — for the purposes of session delivery, neurofeedback display, and closed-loop stimulation adaptation.

I understand that:
• This data is encrypted with AES-256 and stored only on my NeurOne device
• NeurOne cannot access, read, or decrypt this data at any time
• The data is retained on my device until I request deletion or perform a factory reset, at which point it is permanently destroyed via hardware-level secure erase (eMMC SANITIZE), consistent with NeurOne's publicly available biometric data retention and destruction policy
• NeurOne will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from this data
• NeurOne will not share this data with any third party without my separate written consent, except as required by law

I can revoke this authorization at any time from Settings → Privacy → Manage EEG Data Consent. Revoking authorization prevents future EEG data collection but does not retroactively erase data already stored on my device (use factory reset for full erasure).

CONSENT_IRREVERSIBILITY_NOTICE:
Once your anonymised data has been included in a published study, it cannot be individually withdrawn from that dataset. This is a fundamental property of aggregate anonymised data required by Common Rule (45 CFR 46).

However, because NeurOne anonymises your data fresh from your device for each study, withdrawing consent immediately and permanently stops any further data from flowing to any future dataset — including data from sessions that occurred before your withdrawal.

Your session recordings remain on your device under your sole control at all times.
